videos.title: Apollo 14: Mission to Fra Mauro
videos.description: The 1971 Apollo 14 Mission to Fra Mauro, a lunar highland area, is highlighted in this video The mission's primary goal was the collection of lunar rocks and soil samples and lunar exploration. The soil and rock sampling was for the geochronological.

videos.title: Apollo 15: In the Mountains of the Moon
videos.description: This video features the following: (1) extra vehicle activity (EVA); (2) the three traverses of the lunar surface; (3) film taken from the Lunar Rover; (4) hammer and feather tests of Galileo's theory on falling objects in gravity fields.
